2607.16992.title: Automated Cardiac Adipose Tissue Segmentation in Computed Tomography: A Literature Review
2607.16992.paper_summary: This review provides an overview of recent advancements in automated segmentation methods on Computed Tomography (CT) for two types of cardiac fat: Epicardial adipose Tissue (EAT) and Pericardial Adipose Tissue (PAT). These fat deposits, separated by the pericardium, have been linked to various cardiovascular diseases, with EAT receiving the most research attention. Their complex anatomical context makes manual quantification highly time-consuming and prone to considerable inter-observer variability. Automated methods effectively address these complications, offering a more efficient and consistent solution. This study encompasses a broad range of methods, spanning AI as well as non-AI approaches. Additionally, it presents the remaining challenges, including the need for larger annotated public datasets and optimized attenuation thresholds for contrast-enhanced CT. It is demonstrated that automated methods are able to achieve segmentation results comparable to the quality of human annotation, proving their potential as a clinical tool for discovering new biomarkers and enhancing patient outcomes.
2607.16992.paper_summary_zh: 這篇評論提供了有關計算機斷層掃描（CT）中自動分割方法在兩種類型心臟脂肪上的最新進展的概述：心外膜脂肪組織（EAT）和心包脂肪組織（PAT）。這些脂肪沉積物由心包分隔，與各種心血管疾病有關，其中EAT受到的研究關注最多。它們複雜的解剖背景使得手動量化非常耗時，且容易受到觀察者之間的顯著變異影響。自動化方法有效地解決了這些問題，提供了一種更高效且一致的解決方案。本研究涵蓋了廣泛的方法，包括人工智慧（AI）和非人工智慧的方法。此外，它還提出了剩餘的挑戰，包括對更大標註公共數據集的需求以及針對增強對比CT的最佳衰減閾值。研究表明，自動化方法能夠實現與人類標註質量相當的分割結果，證明了它們作為臨床工具在發現新生物標誌物和改善患者結果方面的潛力。
